title: POST /game-api/s2s-api/v1.0/lobby/dedicatedServers/heartBeat
$comment: Observed on 1.8.0.13: 200, 67 bytes, every 61 seconds for the life of the session - the first one 61 s after registration, the next 61 s later, and so on. The request carries this server's own stats and its player list; the answer is the server's inbound channel for the world version and game events. This is the other end of the `DS Heartbeat Stats: FPS: ... frame time (avg: ..., min: ..., max: ...)` log line.

id.description: The dedicatedServerId - note that the heartbeat uses `id` where the room calls use `dedicatedServerId`.

state.description: HostingGame is the only state observed. The enum lists what was seen, not a closed set taken from the binary.

stats.description: The stats block, each member typed by @type. The members observed are frameTime, memory, memory2 and ai_chars_active; the binary's field list for this request (StatsDef@LobbyApiRequestDSHeartbeat) suggests more can appear.

frameTime.description: Milliseconds per frame: avg, min and max since the previous heartbeat.

memory.description: A single number, in kilobytes in the capture (1001833 for a freshly loaded world).

memory2.description: A second memory figure, larger than memory; what it measures was not established.

ai_chars_active.description: 0.0 with nobody in the session, 47.0 once a player had loaded in.

players.description: Who is in the session, as identities. Empty before the first join; [{"identity":"..."}] afterwards.

currentWorldVersion.description: `BanSettings` in every capture - the same string the game-api/world answer carries as its version. What the server does with it was not established.

gameEvents.description: Empty in every capture. This is the only inbound instruction channel observed in the whole exchange, and its element shape is unknown.
